description: This file implements the SocketPort class and related functions for socket management, including socket creation, configuration, data transmission, and event handling across different platforms (Windows, POSIX). It includes socket initialization, buffer management, connection handling, multicast group management, and event processing for network communication.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Handles Windows socket library initialization and cleanup, including WSAStartup and WSARecvMsg function pointer setup.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, handling platform-specific control message parsing to extract interface index information.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Configures a socket to operate in non-blocking mode.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on local node info and optional specific interface binding.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates internal buffers for data transmission.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for a socket to become open within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for ongoing write operations to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for a socket to close within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines the current socket event flags based on internal state and error conditions.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes socket events, calling appropriate handlers for read, write, accept, or error conditions.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffers.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from internal buffers over the socket.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as open and ready for communication.

methods.name: Accepted
methods.description: Handles a new accepted connection.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns the new socket handle.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and updates internal socket handle.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast source group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast source group.
